sources.snippet: Eight different groups abliterated the same AI model, Alibaba’s Qwen3.8-27B. I ran all nine models, base plus the eight variants, through the same four tests: weight forensics, KL divergence, a 13-task benchmark suite, and HarmBench with 400 harmful behaviours.
